headline: Tatum's 32 and George's late three push the streak to five
takeaway: Jayson Tatum scored 32, 15 of them at the line, and Paul George's three with 1:32 left closed out an Orlando team that had cut it to 97–93. Boston has won five straight heading to Houston.

sections.label: 1st quarter
sections.text: Boston went 1-of-10 from three but forced eight turnovers. Hugo González, in his first start of the season, scored all 7 of his points in the quarter. Tatum bumped heads with Jamal Cain and went to the locker room bleeding, then returned without needing stitches.

sections.label: 2nd quarter
sections.text: Payton Pritchard picked up three fouls in 10:40 and sat the rest of the half. Boston stayed ahead on the glass, with eight offensive rebounds and 13 second-chance points by halftime; Tatum had 17 and Luka Garza 9 off the bench.

sections.label: 3rd quarter
sections.text: Boston opened the half on a 14–4 run, capped by a Derrick White three, to lead 69–54. Tristan da Silva hit three threes in 2:28 and Anthony Black added another to tie it 72–72. Boston's only field goal over the last 7:03 was a Sam Hauser three, and Tatum scored the quarter's final 5 points at the line.

sections.label: 4th quarter
sections.text: Black tied it at 79 early in the quarter, and Orlando later got within 97–93. Tatum answered with two mid-range jumpers, and George's three with 1:32 left made it 104–93. George scored 10 in the quarter, and Neemias Queta had two blocks in the final minutes.

performers.name: Jayson Tatum
performers.note: Carried a cold-shooting offense from the line and hit the two jumpers that stopped Orlando's last push.

performers.name: Paul George
performers.note: Scored 10 in the fourth, including the dagger three, though he was 3-of-10 from deep.

performers.name: Luka Garza
performers.note: Gave Boston 21 useful minutes in his first game as the backup center.

oppLine: Anthony Black had 23 points and 8 rebounds and Tristan da Silva had 23 points (five threes) and 10 rebounds; Franz Wagner had a career-high 12 assists but shot 5-of-20.
